name: Uzzek
summary: Southwest of Far Watch Post, Uzzek trains warriors crossing the eastern Barrens. The battle-hardened orc survived many skirmishes across Kalimdor and now tests promising Horde fighters.

sections.title: Veteran of the Plains
sections.body: Southwest of Far Watch Post, Uzzek trains young warriors near the eastern edge of the Barrens. He endured brutal combat in the recent wars. Now he tests those learning to defend themselves against the savage wildlife and raiders troubling the crossing.

faq.answer: Uzzek is a veteran orc warrior stationed in the eastern Barrens, just southwest of Far Watch Post. He guides aspiring Horde warriors in defensive combat.
You can find Uzzek along the bluffs southwest of Far Watch Post. From there, he overlooks the road from Durotar into the Barrens.

faq.q: What role does Uzzek play for Horde warriors?
faq.answer: Uzzek tests young warriors' stamina and resolve with trials such as the Path of Defense. Then he directs them to seasoned masters like Thun'grim Firegaze.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face Uzzek's tests of grit and defensive skill as you leave your first training grounds for the wider Barrens.
As a member of the Horde, you find Uzzek near Far Watch Post. He stands among veteran defenders watching the vulnerable border between Durotar and the untamed savanna.
